name: China Coal Xinji Energy Co.,Ltd
summary: China Coal Xinji Energy Co.,Ltd engages in coal mining and thermal power generation in China and internationally. It is involved in the washing and mining of bituminous and anthracite coal; electricity and heat production and supply; wind power generation; and real estate business. The company was formerly known as SDIC Xinji Energy Co., Ltd. and changed its name to China Coal Xinji Energy Co.,Ltd in January 2017. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Huainan, China.
